# Timer Selection

The GPU-based implementation is measured with `std::steady_clock` and the CPU-based implementation with `SYSTEM_CLOCK`.

# Hardware Selection

Due to the current state of GPU-based solution, there is no possibility of scaling the hardware to multiple nodes.
Therefore, we fixed the hardware for this evaluation.

The measurements were performed on the `gpulab` cluster on node `ampere02`.
This node has an `AMD EPYC 9374F` CPU.
This CPU has two sockets, 32 cores per socket and two threads per core.
The node has `768 GB` RAM and two `A100` GPUs with `80 GB` VRAM. Only one of those GPUs was utilized.
